description.value: Pizza Pizza is a Canadian pizza chain founded in 1967 with over 750 locations coast to coast. The West Kelowna location on Dobbin Road serves pizza and related items with takeout available, making it a quick refuelling stop for cyclists passing through. As a national chain it offers consistent, predictable food including gluten-free crust options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a Pizza Pizza fast food location with takeaway=yes, providing clear evidence for the Takeout amenity. The website's location-specific URL renders a 'This location does not exist' message, but the corporate restaurant locator on the same page lists 'West Kelowna (1)' under BC locations, suggesting the physical store exists but the direct URL is broken. The corporate website (about-us and menu-faq subpages) confirms gluten-free crust options are available, supporting the GF amenity claim; no evidence was found for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: The location-specific URL (https://www.pizzapizza.ca/restaurant-locator/British_Columbia/West_Kelowna/2525-dobbin-road/596) returns 'This location does not exist' on their website, though West Kelowna (1) still appears in the BC restaurant locator list — the direct URL may be broken or the slug changed.
No phone number present in OSM record; could not be verified from the website.
Address and phone could not be confirmed via website due to the broken location page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible Pizza Pizza franchise location confirmed by OSM and the corporate restaurant locator listing West Kelowna; useful to touring cyclists as a quick food stop.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Corporate website menu FAQ confirms gluten-free crust available with dedicated utensils and many gluten-free toppings; allergen/ingredient lists available on site
